module.title: QuSpin exact diagonalization and quantum dynamics
module.expensive_path: Symmetry-reduced sparse Hamiltonian construction, Lanczos eigensolves, and time evolution over many-body Hilbert spaces; workload must exceed the dense small-system shortcut.
module.rationale: The checkout is a cohesive public package whose basis, operator, symmetry, sparse-linear-algebra, and dynamics code are released and tested together. The official examples and tests form one user-facing scientific contract.
excluded: Documentation-only files and notebooks are not runtime checks; extension wheels remain external dependencies unless the maintainer requires their source workspaces to be vendored.
hazards: Published Cython/OpenMP extensions are separate packages; pyproject.toml contains a BDS-3 metadata typo while LICENSE.rst states BSD 3-Clause; platform-specific OpenMP loading must be pinned.
